notes:
Account summary:
-  Arborglen = mid-market ecommerce platform (multi-tenant stores). Heavy seasonal traffic; peak during flash sales.
-  Primary pain: agent latency during returns/refunds, manual ops for refunds, and missed SLAs during spikes. Looking to automate: create/update tickets, call payment gateway for refunds, escalate to ops on failed auto-refunds.
-  Use-case specifics: tool-calling to backend ticketing (custom REST API), refund orchestration via payment gateway tokenization, automated escalation to Opsgenie on >3 failed attempts.
POC scope (requested):
-  2-week sandbox: integrate tool-calling connector (create/update tickets + add metadata), run synthetic traffic to emulate 5k concurrent chats, simulate refunds path (sandbox gateway).
-  Acceptance criteria: average agent-assist latency under 600ms at 2x baseline, successful automated refund rate >= 85% in sandbox, no data exfiltration during tool-calls.
Security and compliance notes:
-  Infosec explicitly: "Need to see KMS envelope flow + audit log examples" — asked for retention controls and per-request audit IDs.
-  PCI team flagged refunds: will require scoped PCI review and DPA addendum for payment token handling.
Integration details / technical asks:
-  Need example webhook + idempotency key handling for ticket create/update (they use idempotent POSTs).
-  Prefers VPC private deployment for production due to residency and network controls; willing to run Dedicated in cloud for initial POC.
-  Wants routing policy: prefer cheaper quantized model for routine summarization; fallback to larger model for uncertain/complex escalations.
Operational constraints & reliability:
-  Concerned about graceful degradation during spikes — wants model fallback + queued tool-calls with backpressure to prevent duplicate refunds.
-  Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + cache TTLs for recent ticket prefixes.
Sales notes / quotes:
